recipe.visualDefinition: A tilted, ornate rectangular frame containing a group portrait in an oval vignette, set against a solid brown background with secondary metadata text in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The tilted inner frame creates a dynamic diagonal contrast against the static square background.
The oval vignette acts as a soft focal point within the rigid rectangular frame.
The warm sepia and cream tones unify the photography with the illustrative border elements.
The primary title follows a curved path that mimics the top of the oval vignette.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central group portrait occupies the middle 60% of the canvas, tilted approximately 15 degrees clockwise.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central oval portrait of five men in suits.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large curved title, move down into the portrait, and then to the secondary text block in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial solid brown negative space surrounds the central tilted frame, providing breathing room for metadata.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Chocolate brown background providing a neutral, warm base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream and off-white used for the frame and text to ensure legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted salmon pink and gold used in the ribbons and frame accents.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with a focus on mid-tones and highlights to create a vintage, aged paper feel.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Victorian-style slab serifs and condensed sans-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick, bubbly slab serifs with a heavy drop shadow.
Secondary text uses a tall, condensed sans-serif with tight tracking.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged 'B' in the second word of the title for emphasis.
Heavy outlining on the main title to separate it from the ornate background.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A decorative, arched display face paired with a utilitarian, condensed sans-serif for information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Victorian slab-serif aesthetic of the main title.
Matches the condensed, high-impact feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid chocolate brown background. In the center, place a tilted cream-colored rectangular frame with ornate Victorian scrollwork and salmon-pink ribbons. Inside the frame, include a sepia-toned oval vignette containing a group of men in 1960s suits.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in an arched path at the top of the tilted frame using a bold, outlined slab-serif. Add secondary stacked text in the upper right corner of the brown background using a condensed sans-serif in cream and gold.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait inside an oval vignette?
Is the background a solid, dark earth tone?

adjustableVariables: Tilt angle of the central frame
Specific shade of the brown background
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or band logos
Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background.
Check that the tilt of the frame feels intentional and not accidental.
Verify that the sepia tones in the photo match the warmth of the border.
Confirm the secondary text is aligned to the right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Tilted Victorian Frame + Oval Vignette + Arched Slab-Serif + Earth Tone Background
